site.name: febrianthomas
site.description: Portfolio, illustrations, and notes by Febrian Thomas.

sections.title: Who Am I?
sections.description: I’m Febrian—a creator, illustrator, and builder who loves turning playful ideas into things people can see and use.

sections.title: What I Do.
sections.description: I draw characters, design interfaces, and build web projects—mixing illustration with clean, interactive code.

sections.title: What I Like.
sections.description: Sketching late at night, experimenting with new tools, animation, cozy games, and a good cup of coffee.
sections.imageAlt: Illustration of a character with raised hands

about.title: About.
about.description: Hi, I’m febrianthomas. Welcome to my little corner of the internet.
about.details: This is where I share more about myself, my work, and the things I enjoy.

donations.title: Support My Work.
donations.description: If you enjoy what I create, you can support me here.
